name: Corleone (Italy)
description: Maroon (purple-red) field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Corleone (a yellow lion on red), with the motto ANIMOSA CIVITAS CORLEONE on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Corleone, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 30 October 1929.

features.role: Corleone arms — yellow lion on red, crowned, with motto ANIMOSA CIVITAS CORLEONE
